lastDecision: First 5m backtest failed first-pass criteria. Do not integrate Session ORB + VWAP Reclaim into Railway paper loop. The strategy is far safer than the failed EMA scalper because trade frequency and drawdown are controlled, but the tested variants still do not have enough net edge after fees/slippage.

researchHypothesis.primaryIdea: Trade only after a defined session opening range forms, then enter either confirmed ORB continuation or fakeout/VWAP reclaim/rejection.
whyDifferentFromFailedScalper: Does not use EMA pullback as the main edge
Uses a defined intraday event: opening range, breakout, fakeout, VWAP reclaim or rejection
Limits trades per session and per day
Starts with liquid symbols only: BTC, ETH, SOL
riskControls: one trade per session per symbol

knownProblems: Only vwap_reclaim_after_sweep had positive gross PnL, but fees turned it negative
ORB breakout and ORB VWAP retest had slightly negative gross PnL before fees
Win rate was only about 30.1% to 36.7%
Profit factor was too low: about 0.50 to 0.69
ETH was the least bad symbol and was slightly positive only in the VWAP reclaim scenario
SOL was weak, especially in the ORB VWAP retest scenario
Some UTC hours/sessions are clearly weak and need filtering before any retest
Session definitions may overfit to the tested date range
Crypto trades 24/7 so session windows are less clean than equity market opens
False breakouts can remain frequent without good confirmation filters
VWAP can lag during sharp liquidation or news moves
blockedChanges: Do not add Session ORB VWAP to Railway paper loop
Do not use OKX API keys
Do not use martingale or increase position size after losses
Do not expand to illiquid altcoins before BTC/ETH/SOL show edge
Do not treat low drawdown alone as edge because net PnL is still negative

successCriteriaForFirstPass.minimumTrades: at least 30-80 trades preferred, but fewer is acceptable if multiple sessions/symbols are represented
successCriteriaForFirstPass.tradesPerDay: low frequency preferred, ideally below 10 across the tested basket
successCriteriaForFirstPass.drawdown: controlled and acceptable relative to 1000 USDT paper balance
successCriteriaForFirstPass.grossPnlBeforeFees: must be positive; otherwise the strategy has no directional edge
successCriteriaForFirstPass.symbolDiversification: result should not depend on one symbol only
successCriteriaForFirstPass.paperLoopDecision: if edge disappears after fees/slippage or only one scenario/symbol works by chance, do not add to paper loop

nextResearch: Do not integrate the current version into Railway paper loop
Use vwap_reclaim_after_sweep as the only potentially salvageable branch because gross PnL was positive before fees
Test ETH-only and ETH/BTC-only VWAP reclaim variants before adding SOL back
Reduce fee drag by requiring stronger R multiple, fewer trades, and better session/hour filters
Review raw report by symbol, session, side, signal type, and exit reason before changing code
If the next variant cannot produce positive net PnL after fees/slippage, reject Session ORB VWAP v1
